summary: The Verge's roundup of gaming deals during Amazon's October Prime Big Deal Days 2023, covering video games for PS5, PS4, Xbox, Switch and PC, plus consoles, controllers, headsets, storage and tabletop games. It lists sale prices and discounts, such as God of War Ragnarök at $62 and Demon's Souls at $30, with short descriptions of each item.
one_line: The Verge rounds up the best gaming deals from Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days across games, hardware, accessories, storage and tabletop games.
key_facts: God of War Ragnarök for PlayStation 5 is $62, down from $70 (11% off), at Amazon.
Demon's Souls (2020), a remake by Bluepoint Games of the 2009 FromSoftware game, is $30 (57% off) as a physical copy at Amazon.
Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope is $30, down from $60 (50% off).
Mario Golf: Super Rush and Super Mario Maker 2 for Nintendo Switch are each $39.99 ($20 off) at Amazon.
Metroid Dread is $40 (33% off) in digital form; it is the fifth mainline Metroid entry and a direct sequel to Metroid Fusion (2002).
A $100 PlayStation Store gift card is $100 and includes a $10 Amazon digital credit with the on-page coupon or code PSN100.
The refurbished Xbox Series X is $400, down from $500 (20% off), at Amazon.
Razer's wired Wolverine V2 Chroma hit a new low of $87.99 ($62 off) and has six remappable buttons.
The Asus ROG Flow Z13 gaming tablet is $893, down from $1300 (31% off).
The WD_Black SN850X 1TB SSD with heatsink is $70, down from $180 (61% off), with read speeds up to 7,300 MB/s.
The WD_Black C50 Storage Expansion Card for Xbox Series X / S is a new low of $124.99 ($25 off).
Tabletop deals include Catan at $27 (45% off), Happy Salmon at $8.63 and Splendor at $19.97 ($25 off).
